# Rule 2 - Killing. Unjustified actions intended to cause serious harm or kill another person are prohibited. Remember that killing requires a very strong RP justification. If you are unsure, ask in AHelp. You have the right to self-defense, but it must not escalate into killing. In other words, you may hit an assailant back, but once they are down, you should not finish them off.
